head.prose:
Proposed core and optional data elements with definitions: the core data elements for a health workforce registry (CDE-HRH). CDE-HRH takes inspiration from the WHO 2015 minimum data set.

This handbook uses "core data elements" and CDE-HRH rather than "minimum data set" or MDS-HRH, because the older term has caused confusion and is not precise. The title of the WHO 2015 publication is cited as published.

The 2015 elements are drafted as structured data-element blocks in section 11.1.

head.prose:
**Purpose.** This table decides what happens to a registration application: register and license, hold it for duplicate review or pending verification, or reject it. The registration officer at the regulatory body uses it when processing a new application (processes HRH-BP-01 and HRH-BP-02). It serves the identity and records requirements [Assign a unique, persistent health worker identifier](#freq:FR-ID-01), [Search, match and merge duplicate records across source systems](#freq:FR-ID-02), [Create, view, update and archive the health worker record…](#freq:FR-REC-01) and [Hold supporting evidence, such as certificates](#freq:FR-REC-02).

Decision table **HRH-DT-01** (the first matching rule applies) formalizes the rules in [**Section 7.1 (Identity management)**](#sec:7-1) and [**Section 7.2 (Records)**](#sec:7-2) governing when a registration application creates a new persistent health worker identifier ([Assign a unique, persistent health worker identifier](#freq:FR-ID-01)), reuses an existing identifier across cadres or specialties, holds a candidate duplicate for manual adjudication ([Search, match and merge duplicate records across source systems](#freq:FR-ID-02)), or rejects an application lacking primary-source qualification attestation ([Create, view, update and archive the health worker record…](#freq:FR-REC-01), [Hold supporting evidence, such as certificates](#freq:FR-REC-02)).

*Source passages cited:* [Identity management](#prose:ch07-identity-management), [Assign a unique, persistent health worker identifier](#freq:FR-ID-01), [Search, match and merge duplicate records across source systems](#freq:FR-ID-02), [Create, view, update and archive the health worker record…](#freq:FR-REC-01), [Hold supporting evidence, such as certificates](#freq:FR-REC-02), and [Register and license a new graduate](#scen:register-and-license-new-graduate). Qualitative states come strictly from the source text; no numeric matching scores or day thresholds are invented.

| Rule | `identityStatus` ([FR-ID-01](#freq:FR-ID-01)) | `qualificationAttestation` ([FR-REC-01](#freq:FR-REC-01), [FR-REC-02](#freq:FR-REC-02)) | `duplicateMatch` ([FR-ID-02](#freq:FR-ID-02)) | `regulatoryStanding` ([FR-REC-02](#freq:FR-REC-02)) | `registrationDecision` | `identifierAction` | Source basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Rule_DT01_01` | `-` | `-` | `-` | `"revoked", "disqualified"` | `"reject-disqualified"` | `"none"` | [FR-REC-02](#freq:FR-REC-02) ([7.2](#sec:7-2)) |
| `Rule_DT01_02` | `"rejected"` | `-` | `-` | `-` | `"reject-unverified-identity"` | `"none"` | [FR-ID-01](#freq:FR-ID-01) ([7.1](#sec:7-1)) |
| `Rule_DT01_03` | `-` | `"rejected"` | `-` | `-` | `"reject-unverified-qualification"` | `"none"` | [FR-REC-01](#freq:FR-REC-01), [FR-REC-02](#freq:FR-REC-02) ([7.2](#sec:7-2)) |
| `Rule_DT01_04` | `"verified", "verified-without-national-id"` | `"attested"` | `"candidate-duplicate"` | `"good-standing", "new-graduate"` | `"hold-duplicate-review"` | `"review-candidate-match"` | [FR-ID-02](#freq:FR-ID-02) ([7.1](#sec:7-1), [13.3](#sec:13-3)) |
| `Rule_DT01_05` | `"verified", "verified-without-national-id"` | `"attested"` | `"existing-confirmed"` | `"good-standing", "new-graduate"` | `"register-and-license"` | `"reuse-existing-hwr-id"` | [FR-ID-01](#freq:FR-ID-01), [FR-ID-02](#freq:FR-ID-02) ([7.1](#sec:7-1)) |
| `Rule_DT01_06` | `"verified", "verified-without-national-id"` | `"attested"` | `"none"` | `"good-standing", "new-graduate"` | `"register-and-license"` | `"assign-new-hwr-id"` | [FR-ID-01](#freq:FR-ID-01), [FR-REC-01](#freq:FR-REC-01), [FR-REC-02](#freq:FR-REC-02) ([5.2](#sec:5-2), [7.1](#sec:7-1), [7.2](#sec:7-2)) |
| `Rule_DT01_07` | `"pending", "unknown"` | `-` | `-` | `-` | `"hold-pending-verification"` | `"none"` | Third state: pending/unknown source check ([FR-ID-01](#freq:FR-ID-01)) |

**Key messages**

- Collect only what is needed, define it precisely, and keep it up to date.
- The minimum data set is a floor, not a ceiling. Countries can extend it.
- International classifications allow comparison across institutions and countries.
- A well-designed registry can produce many NHWA indicators as a by-product of routine operation.
